'''Taradon''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A Jedi Master from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Taradon was a skilled [[Jedi ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for a century. He [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] alongside the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Deelguh/Legends|Deelguh]] as a [[Padawan]] during their adolescence. Wielding a [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|sword]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in combat, Taradon was most at home in the cockpit of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], bringing dozens of criminals to justice along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Piloting six different starfighters and [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboats]] in his career, Taradon would drop out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and destroy his enemies with quick precision on behalf of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Creating a device that was omnicompatible with starfighter designs, [[Taradon's Helm]] became a legendary device that augmented Taradon's already considerable skills using crystalline technology that imbued it with the Force.<ref name="NoP" />

Taradon's last mission took him to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in defense of its stores of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]], which were under threat from the turn-coat Jedi Deelguh. Seeking to bring his former friend to justice, Taradon recognized Deelguh as his equal and decided to pilot his craft into the Rodian's, bringing them both to a fiery end. While his ship was never recovered, Jedi investigating the crash were able to recover flight logs transmitted by Taradon's ship and discovered an unidentifiable surge of energy from the ship. Jedi scholars theorized that the Helm had sought to protect its master, though others argued the Helm would not have disobeyed a command.<ref name="NoP" />
